text:
amy: Quick heads-up — proposing to unpin runtime v3.5 for a 1% midnight canary at 00:45 UTC. Request dry-run + explicit escape-hatch.

ben: +1. Dry-run first. I want deploybot to run a --dry-run and emit a gate report before any traffic.

claire: Gate checklist: p95 < 380ms, 5xx < 0.4%, smoke-eval pass. If any gate trips, first action = flip route weight to 0 for v3.5, then rollback.

deploybot: Deploybot: I can run dry-run and post the gate-report. Sample command: `/unpin runtime=v3.5 --cohort=dryrun --dry-run --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/rt-3.5-midnight.yaml --report-channel=eng-releases`. Dry-run scheduled at 3750015600 (23:45 UTC).

ben: Add tenant exclusions for payment and billing partners to avoid noisy load during warmup. Also add token-drop trace check.

claire: On-call: @ben primary, @amy backup. Manual rollback allowed via `/deploybot rollback runtime=v3.5 --reason="manual triage"`. If auto-rollback triggers, deploybot should create a PT and ping eng-releases.

amy: I'll sign off after I see the dry-run gate-report. One more ops note: set auto-unpin=false for the night window so we require manual go unless a hard abort condition occurs.

ben: PromQL snippets (to paste in gate file):
`histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{runtime="v3.5"}[5m])) by (le))`
and 5xx rate: `sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v3.5",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v3.5"}[5m]))`.

amy: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-escape-hatch — will pin the runbook in channel. Dry-run queued, will post go/no-go here.
